breakdown.description: The traction-free hole boundaries are replaced by artificial symmetry constraints u.n = 0 on every hole
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that imposing an artificial symmetry constraint (u.n = 0) on the hole boundaries was incorrect. The generated specification explicitly corrects this by stating, 'All hole boundaries are traction-free (natural boundary condition); do not impose zero normal displacement on the holes.' This aligns with the ground truth's instruction to 'Keep all four hole boundaries traction-free.'
